themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are navigating high-stakes election campaigns and complex parliamentary coalition negotiations. From Spain's upcoming snap election to government formation battles in Sweden and Germany, right-wing forces are seeking to leverage momentum to dictate coalition terms or secure executive power.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigning aggressively ahead of the November 29 snap election, positioning itself as an indispensable coalition partner for the PP.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Playing a central kingmaker role in Swedish prime ministerial vote negotiations and government formation.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Facing coalition rejections from BSW while building electoral dominance in eastern state politics like Saxony-Anhalt.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Maneuvering for the 2027 presidential race as rivals attempt to counter Marine Le Pen's polling leads.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Tabling no-confidence motions in devolved parliaments and challenging established parties in local council fights.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and political figures are actively building cross-border diplomatic ties and ideological partnerships to project international legitimacy. High-profile bilateral encounters, such as Polish President Nawrocki's summit with Argentina's Javier Milei and Tisza leader Péter Magyar's meeting with Volodymyr Zelenskyy, demonstrate a push for conservative international alignment.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei hosted Polish President Karol Nawrocki in Buenos Aires to solidify economic and strategic ties.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki conducted high-level bilateral diplomacy in Argentina, reinforcing shared conservative values and G20 support.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza leader Péter Magyar held a high-profile summit with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy in Zakarpattia to discuss bilateral relations.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Key allies maintain diplomatic links with US MAGA figures while navigating personnel changes in US-Brazil diplomatic channels.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing politicians and parties across multiple jurisdictions are embroiled in complex legal battles, judicial investigations, and court challenges. Leaders accuse judicial bodies of politicized lawfare while aggressively pursuing counter-suits against electoral authorities and political opponents.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Figures like Jair and Eduardo Bolsonaro face strict Supreme Court supervision and ongoing legal actions in electoral courts.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Party leaders denounce European court rulings while clashing over judicial appointments and filing defamation lawsuits.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: The party files high-stakes legal challenges in regional courts over investigative committees and election exclusion rules.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration faces ongoing legal battles and lawsuits over historical exhibits and deportation procedures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Spokespersons and candidates face legal scrutiny and public fallout over past controversial writings and campaign complaints.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are intensifying calls for strict national preference policies and aggressive anti-immigration measures. Framing immigration as a threat to national identity, public safety, and welfare resources, right-wing actors are pushing for deportations and restrictions on access to public benefits.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demanding strict national priority for Spaniards in public housing and escalating rhetoric against migrant integration.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Senior figures explicitly advocate for large-scale deportations and strict policy boundaries around remigration.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Consistently voting against local refugee settlement plans while advocating for restrictive asylum models.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposing financial penalties on companies hiring foreign workers to enforce national priority in employment.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Executing hardline deportation mandates and voluntary self-deportation agreements for non-citizens.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are championing fiscal populism, combining demands for aggressive spending cuts and tax reductions with protection for populist welfare initiatives. From state downsizing in South America to tax cuts and pension reform demands in Europe, conservative factions are pushing economic restructuring.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration cuts tens of thousands of public sector jobs to enforce fiscal balance and lower public spending.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The ruling coalition debates 2027 budget measures, pushing tax amnesties, youth flat taxes, and pension protection.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushing for dramatic fuel tax cuts and advocating for the total phase-out of municipal property taxes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Demanding immediate VAT reductions on energy while navigating contentious debates over pension eligibility.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposing regional income tax cuts and fiscal incentives for savings ahead of major elections.
